name: Caly Zheng
description: Hi! As president, my role is to oversee our team in various initiatives and events. I lead the team to ensure we’re always supporting the needs and interests of our members!

name: Mark Maligalig
description: Hi y’all, as VP Admin, I work to support our internal communications and help organize our initiatives. In my free time, I enjoy watching drag shows and going to the gym!

name: Kashish Gupta
description: Hi! As VP Academic, I help organize Ada’s Base office hours and tutoring services to support students in their courses. I also gather feedback on academic challenges and help improve the student experience. I also love to read books and travel!

name: Melrita Cyriac
description: Hi! As VP Communications, I’m responsible for promoting our amazing events across multiple platforms and serving as the main point of contact for our email communications. Feel free to reach out :)

name: Selena Chainani
description: As VP Digital Media, I’m the one behind the creation of most of the graphics, posters and promotional material you’ll come across! My work involves maintaining our website and social media. When I’m not here or studying, you can probably find me gaming (currently nursing a Risk of Rain 2 addiction), or making stuff in general - art, prose, music, you name it.

name: Aara Likun Vanatia
description: Hi!! As VP Finance I document yearly spendings, manage reimbursements and look after grant approvals for funding our really cool events/conferences :)

name: Mackenzie Luong
description: As VP Campus Outreach, I handle collaborations with other student groups and campus initiatives and host fun events! In my free time, I enjoy gaming (currently in my Terraria phase), drawing, and making jewelry.

name: Angela Solanki
description: Hey guys! As VP Industry Outreach, I help maintain relationships with companies and industry folks, as well as host fun events (such as Coffee&&Code)! In my free time you can probably find me building legos :-)

name: Ravinder Kaur
description: Hi! As VP Conference Operations, I handle behind-the-scenes logistics like booking accommodations and making sure everything runs smoothly at our conferences. I love organizing travel almost as much as I love going on trips myself!

name: Samia Rahman
description: Hi! As VP Conference - Finance, I manage all financial aspects for our fun conferences, from grant applications to student reimbursements! In my free time, I love trying out new restaurants and traveling :)
